variables.name: Total income
variables.description: Sum of all transactions marked as income (paychecks, freelance, transfers in).

variables.name: Total expenses
variables.description: Sum of all transactions marked as expense (bills, food, shopping, etc.).

variables.name: Net balance

jsonCsvConverter.summary: CSV is treated as a table of rows. JSON → CSV expands an array of objects into columns from the union of keys. CSV → JSON maps each data row to an object using the header row as keys.

variables.name: Record array
variables.description: List of objects (JSON) or table rows (CSV).

variables.name: Column names
variables.description: Derived from object keys or the CSV header row.

variables.name: Field values
variables.description: Values written into CSV cells or JSON properties.

notes: Client-side only—files stay on your device.
Prefer flat objects for clean CSV columns.

xmlJsonConverter.summary: XML is walked into a JSON tree. Attributes are stored as @name keys; mixed content uses #text. JSON → XML reverses the mapping into well-formed UTF-8 XML.

variables.name: Element name
variables.description: XML tag that becomes a JSON property (or vice versa).

variables.name: Attribute
variables.description: XML attribute stored under an @-prefixed JSON key.

variables.name: Text node
variables.description: Character data when an element has attributes or child elements.

notes: Invalid XML surfaces a clear parse error before conversion.
Array-valued siblings become repeated XML elements.

yamlJsonConverter.summary: YAML is loaded into a JavaScript value with js-yaml, then pretty-printed as JSON—or dumped back to indented YAML with stable formatting.

variables.name: Document value
variables.description: The parsed YAML/JSON structure (object, array, or scalar).

variables.name: Indent width
variables.description: Two-space indentation used when emitting YAML.

variables.name: Map keys
variables.description: Object keys preserved in original order when possible.

notes: Keep secrets local—ideal for .env-adjacent configs that never leave the machine.
Large documents may take a moment to stringify.

csvTsvConverter.summary: Each line is parsed into cells with the source delimiter, then re-serialized with the target delimiter. Cell contents are unchanged.

variables.name: Separator
variables.description: Comma for CSV or tab for TSV.

variables.name: Field value
variables.description: A single table cell, possibly quoted when needed.

notes: Works entirely offline after the page loads.
Use UTF-8 exports for best cross-app compatibility.

htmlMarkdownConverter.summary: HTML is reduced to Markdown via Turndown (ATX headings, fenced code). Markdown is rendered to HTML with marked under GFM defaults.

variables.name: HTML source
variables.description: Tags and text to convert into Markdown.

variables.name: Parse tree
variables.description: Intermediate structure used by the Markdown renderer.

notes: Client-side libraries only—content never leaves the browser.
Prefer semantic HTML for cleaner Markdown.

base64TextConverter.summary: Encoding turns UTF-8 bytes into Base64. Decoding reverses the process with atob + TextDecoder after whitespace cleanup.

variables.name: Base64 string
variables.description: ASCII-safe encoded form of the bytes.

notes: Never paste production secrets into shared machines.
Padding errors surface as Invalid Base64 messages.

propertiesJsonConverter.summary: Each non-comment properties line splits on the first unescaped = or : into a JSON string map. Export writes key=value lines with escaping.

variables.name: Property value
variables.description: Right-hand string stored in JSON or properties.

notes: Flat maps only—ideal for Spring and Android string tables.

pngJpgConverter.summary: The source image is decoded, optionally resized onto a Canvas, then encoded with canvas.toBlob. JPG uses a quality factor; PNG preserves lossless pixels.

variables.name: Source bitmap
variables.description: Decoded PNG or JPG pixels loaded via Image / createImageBitmap.

variables.name: Output size
variables.description: Width×height after resize mode (original, max, exact, or percent).

variables.name: JPEG quality
variables.description: 0–1 compression factor passed to canvas.toBlob for JPG output.

notes: Large images may take a moment to encode.

webpPngConverter.summary: Source pixels are drawn to Canvas at the chosen size, then exported with toBlob as PNG or WEBP.

variables.name: Live preview
variables.description: Object URL of the encoded result shown beside the original.

notes: Use quality near 1.0 for near-lossless WEBP.

heicJpgConverter.summary: HEIC bytes are decoded locally to a raster, drawn to Canvas with optional resize, then encoded as JPEG.

variables.name: Decoded bitmap
variables.description: Intermediate image produced by the local HEIC decoder.

variables.name: JPEG quality
variables.description: Compression level for the final JPG.

notes: Very large HEIC files may need more memory.

svgPngConverter.summary: SVG → PNG draws the vector into Canvas. PNG → SVG writes an SVG document whose <image> href is a data-URI PNG.

variables.name: Vector source
variables.description: Scalable markup loaded as an image.

variables.name: Raster output
variables.description: Pixel bitmap at the chosen size.

variables.name: SVG wrapper
variables.description: SVG shell embedding the PNG data URI.

bmpPngConverter.summary: BMP is decoded to a bitmap, redrawn at the target size, then either PNG-encoded via toBlob or packed into a BITMAPINFOHEADER BMP.

variables.name: RGBA buffer
variables.description: Canvas ImageData used for BMP packing.

variables.name: Background
variables.description: Fill used when flattening transparency for BMP.

icoPngConverter.summary: PNG → ICO scales the logo to each selected size and packs PNG payloads into an ICO. ICO → PNG reads the directory and extracts the largest image.

variables.name: Favicon sizes
variables.description: Square dimensions included in the ICO.

variables.name: Icon frame
variables.description: One resolution entry inside the ICO directory.

notes: Prefer a square source logo for best results.

tiffJpgConverter.summary: TIFF bytes become RGBA through UTIF, then JPG via Canvas. JPG → TIFF draws to Canvas and encodes with UTIF.encodeImage.

variables.name: TIFF directory
variables.description: Image file directory describing width, height, and strips.

notes: Very large TIFFs need adequate memory.

pdfTextConverter.summary: PDF → Text walks each page with PDF.js getTextContent. Text → PDF wraps lines with jsPDF and paginates to letter size.

variables.name: PDF page
variables.description: One page of the source document.

variables.name: Progress
variables.description: current/total pages shown in the UI bar.

notes: Encrypted PDFs may fail to open.

imagesPdfConverter.summary: Images → PDF embeds each file as a full page. PDF → Images rasterizes pages with PDF.js and packages a ZIP.

variables.name: Render scale
variables.description: PDF.js viewport scale for sharper exports.

htmlMarkdownPdfConverter.summary: Markdown is compiled to HTML, then html2canvas captures the layout and jsPDF paginates the bitmap across A4 pages.

variables.name: PDF pages
variables.description: A4 slices of the captured image.

notes: Very long documents may take longer to rasterize.

pdfMergeSplit.summary: Merge copies all pages from each PDF into one document. Split exports each page or each range as its own PDF inside a ZIP.

variables.name: Source PDF
variables.description: One input file in the merge list.

notes: Progress updates after each file or page.

mp4Mp3Converter.formula: MP3 = FFmpeg(-vn -c:a libmp3lame, MP4); MP4 = FFmpeg(-c:a aac, MP3)
mp4Mp3Converter.summary: MP4 → MP3 strips video and encodes audio with LAME. MP3 → MP4 remuxes/encodes audio into an MP4/AAC container. Progress events drive the live percentage bar.
notes: Keep clips reasonable for browser memory.
Engine loads once per session and is reused.

wavMp3Converter.summary: WAV is encoded to MP3 with libmp3lame; MP3 is decoded to 16-bit PCM WAV. FFmpeg progress updates the UI percentage.
notes: Very long lossless WAV files use more RAM.

movMp4Converter.summary: MOV/MP4 are re-encoded with H.264/AAC inside FFmpeg.wasm. Progress callbacks feed the percentage bar.

variables.name: Video encoder
variables.description: H.264 encoder used for browser-friendly output.

variables.name: Audio encoder
variables.description: AAC track paired with the video.

variables.name: Quality factor
variables.description: Constant rate factor biasing smaller/faster encodes.

notes: Prefer shorter clips on low-memory devices.
WASM loads once per tab session.

webmMp4Converter.summary: Containers are transcoded with FFmpeg.wasm. Load UI covers core/wasm download; process UI maps FFmpeg progress to a percentage bar.

variables.name: WebM video
variables.description: libvpx-vp9 encoder path when targeting WebM.

variables.name: Encode %
variables.description: Live percentage from FFmpeg progress events.

notes: First load downloads the WASM core (~30MB+).
Subsequent conversions reuse the loaded engine.

oggFlacMp3Converter.summary: OGG/FLAC inputs are decoded and re-encoded to MP3 with libmp3lame inside FFmpeg.wasm, with live progress events.

variables.name: Lossy output
variables.description: MPEG-1 Audio Layer III at ~192 kbps.

notes: Large FLAC files need adequate RAM.

cryptoProfit.formula: Net P&L = (Sell − sell fees) − (Buy + buy fees); ROI = Net P&L / Cost basis
cryptoProfit.summary: Computes after-fee profit or loss on a crypto trade and the break-even exit price.
notes: Does not model funding rates, slippage, or taxes.

cryptoDca.formula: Each period: tokens += PMT / price; price *= (1 + monthly growth)
cryptoDca.summary: Simulates dollar-cost averaging with a constant annualized growth assumption.
notes: Results are educational scenario estimates only.

cryptoMarketCap.summary: Values a crypto asset from float and spot price.
notes: Not financial advice. Liquidity and locked supply can distort useful market cap.

cryptoFdv.summary: Fully diluted valuation assuming today’s price on the entire supply.

variables.name: Max supply
variables.description: Hard cap or fully diluted supply.

notes: Large FDV/circ gaps imply future dilution risk.

cryptoTokenPrice.summary: Back-solves implied token price from a market-cap or FDV target.

variables.name: Supply base
variables.description: Circulating or max supply matching V.

notes: Informational scenario tool—not an offering price recommendation.

cryptoTokenomics.formula: Circulating ≈ TGE + vested(t) + emissions × months (capped at total supply)
cryptoTokenomics.summary: Projects unlocked float with cliff, linear vesting, and emissions.
notes: Simplified schedule model—real unlock charts can be multi-tranche.

cryptoLiquidity.formula: x · y = k; Δy = y − k/(x + Δx_eff) with fee on Δx
cryptoLiquidity.summary: Constant-product AMM spot price, LP share, swap output, and price impact.

variables.name: Reserves
variables.description: Token and quote reserves in the pool.

variables.name: Pool fee
variables.description: Basis points charged on swap input.

cryptoStaking.summary: Compound staking growth across daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly schedules.
notes: APRs change; slashing and price risk apply.

cryptoRoi.summary: Total return and annualized performance over a holding period.

cryptoTokenLaunchCost.summary: Sums deploy, development, liquidity, audit, marketing, and legal with a buffer.
notes: Not legal, financial, or launch advice.

bcUsedVehiclePst.formula: Taxable = max(Purchase, Black Book)    ·    PST = Taxable × Rate(tier, ZEV)
bcUsedVehiclePst.summary: British Columbia private-sale used-vehicle PST (2026) is charged on the greater of purchase price and Canadian Black Book wholesale value. Zero-emission vehicles are 0%. Other vehicles use luxury tiers: 12% under $125,000, 15% from $125,000–$149,999, and 20% at $150,000+.

variables.name: Purchase price
variables.description: Amount paid to the private seller, in CAD.

variables.name: Black Book wholesale
variables.description: Estimated Canadian Black Book wholesale value ICBC may use.

variables.name: Taxable value
variables.description: The greater of P and B.

variables.name: PST rate
variables.description: 0% if ZEV; otherwise 12%, 15%, or 20% by luxury tier.

notes: Planning estimate only—ICBC assesses the amount at vehicle transfer.
Confirm current ZEV eligibility and Black Book value with ICBC.

bulkCutMacroPlanner.formula: BMR = 10w + 6.25h − 5a + s    ·    TDEE = BMR × activity    ·    Target = TDEE ± (lb/wk × 3500 ÷ 7)
bulkCutMacroPlanner.summary: Mifflin–St Jeor BMR, activity-scaled TDEE, experience-capped weekly bulk/cut rates, and protein-forward macro splits with optional training-day carb cycling.

variables.name: Training tier
variables.description: Caps safe weekly rate and sets protein g/kg.

notes: Estimates only—not medical or dietary advice.

financialFreedomPropertyPlanner.formula: FIRE# = annual spend ÷ SWR    ·    Net worth_y = portfolio_y + Σ property equity
financialFreedomPropertyPlanner.summary: Year-by-year simulation of salary, side income, inflated expenses, blended investment returns, and rental property down payments, debt service, and equity.

salaryCtcInHand.formula: In-hand = Gross − Employee PF − Income Tax − PT    ·    Tax per FY 2025-26 slabs
salaryCtcInHand.summary: India CTC unpacked into basic, HRA, allowances, PF, and income tax under new or old regime with HRA and 80C deductions.

reverseDietPlanner.formula: Calories_w = min(maintenance, Calories_{w−1} + bump_w)    ·    bump_w = planned or planned/2 if still losing
reverseDietPlanner.summary: Raises calories weekly toward maintenance; shrinks the bump when observed weight change stays below the target gain band.

variables.name: Weekly calorie increase
variables.description: Planned kcal added each week, optionally halved when adapting.

emergencyFundRunwayPlanner.formula: Runway months = savings ÷ monthly expenses    ·    Shock adjusts income or expenses
emergencyFundRunwayPlanner.summary: Measures emergency runway and stress-tests job loss, medical bills, rent hikes, or lost partner income.

multiGoalSavingsPlanner.formula: Sequential: fund by priority    ·    Split: allocate by urgency weights    ·    Recommend earlier all-done plan
multiGoalSavingsPlanner.summary: Compares sequential vs split funding across multiple savings goals and recommends the faster on-time path.

variables.name: Monthly budget
variables.description: Amount available to allocate across goals.

bodyRecompPlanner.formula: Target = TDEE − volumeCap    ·    Protein g/kg rises with hard sets/week
bodyRecompPlanner.summary: Recomp calories and macros with a training-volume deficit cap and higher protein at higher weekly sets.

variables.name: Hard sets / week
variables.description: Caps deficit and sets protein density.

freelanceTrueRatePlanner.formula: Invoice = reverse(net through tax, FX, processor, platform)
freelanceTrueRatePlanner.summary: Fee waterfall from invoice to net with reverse math so you bill enough after fees and admin time.

variables.name: Desired take-home
variables.description: Monthly net target after tax reserve.

weddingBudgetCashflowPlanner.formula: Balance_m = Balance_{m−1} + save − Σ deposits/finals in month m
weddingBudgetCashflowPlanner.summary: Line-item wedding budget with deposit and final payment cashflow against savings.

variables.name: Deposit share
variables.description: Portion due early for each line item.

babyFirstYearCostPlanner.formula: Month net = income(leave%) + partner − recurring − childcare(after start)
babyFirstYearCostPlanner.summary: First-year baby costs with parental leave income bridge and childcare start month.

variables.name: Pay during leave
variables.description: Percent of normal income while on leave.

notes: Not legal or benefits advice—enter your own leave terms.

subscriptionRunwayAudit.summary: Pause subscriptions to measure emergency runway gained and annual savings.
notes: Private browser tool—no cancellation fees taken.

keepLeaseBuyCarTco.formula: Cumulative cost_year for keep, lease, buy    ·    cheapest = min of the three
keepLeaseBuyCarTco.summary: Year-by-year total cost of ownership comparing keep vs lease vs buy.

variables.name: Km per year
variables.description: Drives fuel cost for each fork.

notes: Currency-agnostic; enter local fuel price per liter.
